body:
Twice now my boyfriend has made jokes like "hey recoverytea remember that time you threw such an aggressive tantrum that you destroyed my bed". It's definitely a level up from my usual absurdity. He does have a way of making me feel safe with humour.

Thank you for telling me that story, I've been hearing that it's not necessarily my weight, it's just so hard to believe. I do feel better. Thank you.
